description: The person's saved voices, and the voice library searched by how the voice should sound (for example "calm even narrator", "warm british woman"). Shows the person a picker where they play each voice, pick one of their saved voices, search again in their own words and choose (where their chat shows cards). Returns their saved voices and up to six found voices, each with a link to listen. No `search`: only their saved voices. `page` gives other voices for the same words. In make it for me you pick the voice yourself: search through fuzzframe_action, so no picker shows, and put it on the brief.

page.description: 0 (default) for the best matches, 1 and up for others

search.description: A few words on how it should sound; empty for their saved voices only

name: voices
title: Find voices
